references.text: The first census of the tribe of Asher gave the same number: 41,500 men, confirming the consistency in the census.
The second census of the tribe of Asher on the plains of Moab shows 53,400 men, demonstrating the tribe's growth during the wilderness journey.
Asher was the son of Jacob and Zilpah, Leah's maidservant. This is the origin of the tribe.
Jacob's blessing over Asher promised rich food and royal delicacies, a prophecy of the tribe's future prosperity.
